decisions.reason: The XL package simply extends the established anamnesis app to larger practices, so it builds directly on the firm's existing knowledge and in-house development, its early results are easy to interpret, and it costs little to maintain.

Support for dental assistants rests on the firm's core strengths in customer service, training and domain know-how, and its dedicated page signals commitment, so the firm can assimilate user feedback and improve the offering rather than withdraw it.
